title: Kevin O'Connell: Second-round LB Jake Golday has similar characteristics to Andrew Van Ginkel

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kevin O'Connell: Second-round LB Jake Golday has similar characteristics to Andrew Van Ginkel
sources.description: Second-round pick Jake Golday has been working with the Vikings' off-ball linebackers since joining the team in April, but his long-term fit in the defense may not be that straightforward.
